title: 3.0beta9 Unable to Build
body:

comments.body:
I have no problems building from current dev. Double check documentation on building.
Make sure you have updated Android Studio to latest version.
And maybe checkout this:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oc7aG0qrIMvK57unMqPEOoLt-J8UT1mxTKdTAxm8-po
you may try clear studio cache

Got it working, thank you. That document helped. I was not downloading the right branch correctly. 

However, any idea why it says I need to rebuild in just a few days?
